description: Connect one of the user's own Google Ads accounts for the free audit: body {customer_id: the ten digits at the top of Google Ads, like 123-456-7890, note: optional}. An invitation is sent to that account at once; the user accepts it in Google Ads under Admin, Access and security, Managers, and the account is connected within minutes. Have the user say the customer id themselves, and tell them to accept only the invitation they asked for. Free: needs a key and no plan. Owners and admins only. -- MakeHybrid API plan, POST /google-ads/v1/connect, group google-ads.
